newsitem.title: USA: Adaptec acquires Sigmax Technologies, Inc.
newsitem.headline: Adaptec acquires Sigmax Technologies, Inc.

text.p: Adaptec Inc said it had acquired Sigmax Technologies Inc of Sunnyvale, California for $14.4 million in cash.
Sigmax Technologies, which was founded in 1994, develops CD-ROM controllers for ATAPI CD-ROM drives.
Adaptec said the acquisition will be accounted for under the purchase method of accounting.

It said it was evaluating the allocation of the purchase price to the assets of Sigmax. It said it might include in-process technology that will be written off in the third quarter of its 1997 fiscal year and goodwill that will be amortized over the benefit period.
Adaptec makes network products for the systems and products of major computer and peripheral manufacturers.
